events.original: 12 kg gas was expected to make static hover infeasible. Assertion returned true.
events.cause: At 293.15 K and 600 L, 12 kg means about 16.8 bar; pressure-derated lift can still exceed weight. The original expectation was wrong.
events.correction: Use 5 kg for explicitly insufficient pressure and set fixture rigid-body mass consistently. Same 249.56 kg low/high/descent counterexample is unchanged. No physical model or landing threshold was relaxed.

events.original: Expected released driverInput.throttle===0; interface returned omitted axis.
events.cause: Empty input object is the established zero-axis representation.
events.correction: Check omitted-or-zero semantic and exact physical body/forces preserved; no implementation limit changed.

events.original: After ordinary pause release, physicsUnchanged was false even though body pose/mode fingerprint matched.
events.cause: The _lastInput shape changed from explicit zero/false axes to an empty object; a manual leading attitude reference could also be recaptured by the normal release path.
events.correction: Input release is idempotent with preserved key shape; diagnostic matrix uses a separate DOM-input freeze without mutating physical control references. Full-state equality assertions retained and repeated for airborne E/1, focus, blur and hidden events.

events.original: Independent road support differed by 0.1200000000000001 m; actual default-regen passage crossed a 12 cm raised paving band.
events.correction: Only split the east footway at the existing 8 m vehicle mouth; preserve the original <0.12 m navigation check and independently require <=0.02 m vehicle-mouth continuity. Unrelated authored solids stay exactly equal.

events.original: The inherited helper explicitly accepted only MODEL_VERSION 3.14.0.
events.correction: Reviewed and retained the same no-migrator policy for 3.15: history is readable/exportable; unavailable solver execution is rejected. Added actual archived 3.14 task read/export and rejection test instead of relabelling old snapshots.

events.case: input release representation after matrix repair
events.original: The earlier new pilot test required _lastInput to become exactly {}, which conflicts with idempotent diagnostic freeze when the pre-release object contains explicit zero/false keys.
events.correction: Keep all axes cleared, preserve original key shape and require a second release to leave the full exported physical snapshot unchanged. The existing body, forces and automated references checks are retained.

events.original: tests/vehicle-dynamics-3.11.test.mjs sent {roll:1,pitch:1} and required peak tilt <5 degrees. This failed on the actual 3.15 solver.
events.cause: The historical assertion expected G to silently discard explicit pitch; accepting that received pitch is an intentional 3.15 behavior change requested by the user.
events.correction: Preserve the original Z/B lateral-translation <5 degree and >1 m gates with roll-only input. Add a separate combined request requiring accepted pitch, >20 degree physical pitch, >1 m lateral travel and exactly zero commanded roll rate. No actuator limits or physical success criteria changed.

events.case: Inherited exact city geometry contract omitted the 3.15 vehicle-mouth paving split
events.original: Final aggregate failed at qa/city-geometry-scope.mjs:50 through qa/exterior-materials-check.mjs: 1948 !== 1947.
events.cause: One original 12 cm paving box plan-foundry-paving-110.5 was intentionally replaced by two exact south/north pieces, leaving the existing 8 m vehicle mouth open; the old helper counted both as unchanged historical entities.
events.correction: Freeze the original failure and process receipt. Validate only these two explicit replacement shapes and the 8 m gap; reconstruct the exact original single box before existing historical counts and canonical hashes. Preserve every other geometry/tower/addition assertion and add rejection fixtures for unauthorized split changes. No production runtime change.

repairFindings.finding: First draft used deep object equality against a JSON fixture; the runtime object includes an optional color: undefined property omitted by JSON, so the exact geometry passed values but failed property representation.
repairFindings.correction: Compare the two explicit paving objects with the same existing 1e-9 canonical geometry representation used by immutable tower and city hashes. Defined extra fields, numeric changes, missing or duplicate pieces remain rejected.

verification.scope: Only affected helper regression callers; no production changes or GPU acceptance. Parent will rerun full aggregate on the same current build.
